## What's Changed
* Review follow-up: bug fixes, hardening and test coverage by @mickem in https://github.com/mickem/check_nsclient/pull/4
* Add `results` commands to poll the passive result cache and feed Nagios by @mickem in https://github.com/mickem/check_nsclient/pull/5

## New Contributors
* @mickem made their first contribution in https://github.com/mickem/check_nsclient/pull/4

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mickem/check_nsclient/compare/1.0.0...1.1.0
Moved `check_nsclient` from NSCP to its own repository to speed-up builds
